newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Foreign Minister to visit Arafat on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Foreign Minister to visit Arafat on Friday.

text.p: Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo will visit Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Friday, Prime Minister Wim Kok said on Thursday.

"Minister van Mierlo will visit chairman Arafat tomorrow because it is our view that of course we should be in close contact with the Prime Minister and government of Israel at the same time as the Palestinians in order to explore... possibilities for lasting peace," Kok told journalists at joint press conference with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Natanyahu.
Kok said the Netherlands would be informing the United States of Van Mierlo's trip.

Netanyahu was in the Netherlands for bilateral, political and economic talks with the Dutch, who currently hold the revolving EU presidency, although talks had concentrated on the situation in the Middle East.
"The main point on the agenda was the frank and open talks we had about the present situation in the Middle East peace process and the lack of progress," Kok said.
Standing at his side, Netanyahu said the two had discussed the contribution of the EU to the peace process.
